digest.component_or_area: Verified gate CI workflow (macOS pytest cell)
propositions: The macOS Verified gate cell invokes pytest with marker selection `-m "platform_compat and not external"` from the trusted-main workflow definition, but the platform_compat marker is applied only by conftest.py at collection time in the patchset tree being tested.

For any patchset whose tree predates the platform_compat auto-marker introduction, zero tests are collected under the marker selection, causing pytest to exit with code 5 (no tests ran) and failing the gate job.
The Ubuntu cells pass because they run the full test suite without marker filtering, exposing the defect as macOS-only and allowing tree-skew regression.
The fix maps pytest exit code 5 to success (0) only on the macOS cell in the default-suite step, restoring pre-regression behavior while preserving current-tree performance gains.
Ubuntu cells must continue failing on exit code 5 to catch real empty-suite failures.
Rewording of shell comments to avoid false-positive matches with the predates-gate guard's path-regex scanner on literal repo paths in non-executable comment text.
